provenance.source: Maximum of saturated raw frames in this library. The sensor is 14-bit, so a clipped frame reaches 16383. Recorded before the camera profiles existed, in pipelines/stacking/exposure_saturation.py.
The pipeline's long-standing default for raw frames: just under the 16-bit maximum of 65535, applied to every camera. It was never measured per camera.

notes: OPEN QUESTION: this threshold sits above the clip ceiling of 16383, so a saturated pixel could never reach it, and saturation checks that use it would always report none for raw D5300 frames read at their native 14-bit scale. The module docstring of pipelines/stacking/exposure_saturation.py records the same problem. Not yet checked against real D5300 frames here. The value is kept as it was so that behaviour does not change during the profile refactor.
